findings.title: TypeScript compilation failure in FeaturedProductsSection (TS2339)
findings.description: Property 'slug' does not exist on type '{ id: string; title: string; }'. Running `npm run typecheck` failed with TS2339 on line 415.
findings.evidence: tsc --noEmit exited with code 1 before fix; exited with code 0 after fix.
findings.remediation: Updated key to `key={option.id || option.title}` in FeaturedProductsSection.tsx.

findings.title: Overly broad permission class on ActivityLogListView
findings.description: ActivityLogListView used `permission_classes = [IsAdminUser | IsStaffOrAnalyst]`, which inadvertently allowed content_manager, product_manager, support_manager, and engineer to read system security audit logs.
findings.evidence: test_activity_log_restricted_to_super_admin_website_admin_analyst returned 200 for content_manager before fix; returns 403 after fix.
findings.remediation: Implemented `IsActivityLogViewer` in apps/users/api/v1/permissions.py, restricting access to super_admin, website_admin, and analyst only.

findings.title: Activity log navigation entry in admin sidebar omitted analyst role
findings.description: The activity log entry in adminNavSections was restricted to `['super_admin', 'website_admin']`, hiding the menu item from read-only analysts despite backend permission and analyst manual claiming access.

findings.title: Authentication routes lacked page-level noindex meta tag fallback
findings.description: Auth routes (/fa/login, /fa/register, /fa/forgot-password) relied exclusively on robots.txt disallow rules without explicit HTML meta robots noindex fallback.
findings.evidence: Exported `metadata: Metadata = { robots: { index: false, follow: false } }` in `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/layout.tsx`.
findings.remediation: Added server-side metadata export with `robots: { index: false, follow: false }` to AuthLayout.

findings.title: Customer role operational manual missing from admin-guides directory
findings.description: The `docs/admin-guides/` directory contained manuals for the 8 staff roles but lacked a comprehensive guide for the Customer role (`customer`).
findings.remediation: Authored Persian operational manual covering customer portal (/dashboard), profile, calculations, notifications, public tools, and security boundaries.

findings.title: Runbook claimed standalone output mode without next.config.ts configuration
findings.description: The deployment guide specified running Next.js via standalone output, but `output: 'standalone'` is not enabled in next.config.ts; standard Next.js server output is used.
findings.remediation: Updated deployment runbook and checklist to document standard `next start` command.

findings.title: Earlier report snippet contained placeholder phone and retail InStock availability
findings.description: Phase 12.27 SEO report snippet included +98-21-88888888 and availability: InStock as illustrative examples. Independent codebase audit confirmed actual code does not output fake data.
findings.status: VERIFIED FALSE IN CODE / SAFEGUARD CONFIRMED
findings.evidence: ProductJsonLd in product-detail-client.tsx only emits offers if price is numeric; availability is never invented; Organization JSON-LD is not hardcoded.
findings.remediation: Documented in SEO audit report that production JSON-LD adheres strictly to real business data provenance.
